materials.description: Shard of bone with a golden shine. Material used for crafting items. Exceedingly rare to find. materials.name: Blood-Tainted Excrement

materials.description: Eggs of large crabs which dwell in the shallows. Materials used for crafting items. A nutritious foodstuff that warms from within. The flavor is exquisite. Only those of comfort and means know the truth: a crab's eggs are more delectable than its meat.

system.overview:
Reforged completely overhauls Elden Ring's crafting system to dramatically reduce the need to tediously collect and farm specific items around the world.
Crafting is now based on a system of breaking down ingredients found in the world into certain base elements - called Alchemics, Substances, Extracts, and Amalgams - and these base elements are used in crafting recipes. This allows items to be made with a much variety of ingredients, and makes passively collecting resources while exploring much more worth it.
Please see the bottom of the page for a full list of all crafting recipes.
